OrderCreated.Title: Order created
OrderCreated.MessageTemplate: Your order was created successfully for {totalPrice} points.

PaymentCompleted.Title: Wallet top-up completed
PaymentCompleted.MessageTemplate: {points} points were added to your wallet.

RefundSubmitted.Title: Refund request submitted
RefundSubmitted.MessageTemplate: Your refund request for {refundAmount} points is being reviewed.

RefundApproved.Title: Refund request approved
RefundApproved.MessageTemplate: Your refund of {refundAmount} points was approved and credited.

RefundRejected.Title: Refund request rejected
RefundRejected.MessageTemplate: Your refund request was rejected. Reason: {reason}

ChangeProposalCreated.Title: Meal item needs your response
ChangeProposalCreated.MessageTemplate: {dishName} is not available in enough quantity. Please choose a replacement or refund option.

ChangeProposalAccepted.Title: Change proposal accepted

ChangeProposalItemRefundRequested.Title: Item refund requested

ChangeProposalOrderRefundRequested.Title: Order refund requested

SessionAutoRejected.Title: Order cancelled automatically

SessionAutoConfirmed.Title: Order confirmed automatically

VerificationSubmitted.Title: Verification submitted
VerificationSubmitted.MessageTemplate: Your identity verification request is being reviewed.

VerificationApproved.Title: Verification approved

VerificationRejected.Title: Verification rejected
VerificationRejected.MessageTemplate: Your identity verification request was rejected. Reason: {reason}
